title: Feature 018 additive IR fragment (DRAFT, not implemented)
description: Additive to specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/workflow.schema.json under apiVersion sagat-octopus-orchestrator.io/v1 (ADR-0032). T018-010 merges it. Publication refuses the field unless the server's `resetReapply` capability is enabled (existing UNSUPPORTED_NODE/capability rules). Absent means false: the Update's arguments are not retained and a reset reports it NOT_REAPPLIED (NOT_RETAINED).

reapplyOnReset.description: When true, the canonical arguments of every applied instance of this Update are retained as a content-addressed payload referenced by its state.updated journal row (charged to tenant_content_bytes), so a reset with reapply UPDATES or ALL can re-validate and re-apply it. Not a classification carrier (FR-016-004).
